diagnostics.cancelled.title: Translation cancelled
diagnostics.cancelled.detail: Your original text and settings are preserved. Translate again when ready.
diagnostics.offline.title: You appear to be offline
diagnostics.offline.detail: Reconnect and retry. You do not need to enter your text or service settings again.
diagnostics.no-content.title: No translatable text found
diagnostics.no-content.detail: Wait for the page to load and retry, or check this site’s translation scope. You can also select text to translate.
diagnostics.unsupported-page.title: This page cannot be translated directly
diagnostics.unsupported-page.detail: Browser internal pages and extension stores restrict extension access. Try translation on a regular webpage.
diagnostics.page-unavailable.title: The page translation component is unavailable
diagnostics.page-unavailable.detail: Refresh the page and retry, and check that the extension can access this website. Use a regular webpage instead of browser internal pages or extension stores.
diagnostics.source-closed.title: The original page is no longer available
diagnostics.source-closed.detail: Reopen the page you want to translate, then open FluentRead again.
diagnostics.context-invalid.title: Refresh this page after the extension update
diagnostics.context-invalid.detail: Save any unsubmitted work on the page, then refresh to continue translating.
diagnostics.authentication.title: Check service credentials or permissions
diagnostics.authentication.detail: Check that your API key is valid and your account can access the selected model. You can also select another service in settings.
diagnostics.model-configuration.title: The selected model is unavailable
diagnostics.model-configuration.detail: Check the model name and endpoint in service settings and test the connection. Save, then return here to retry.
diagnostics.configuration.title: Check the current service configuration
diagnostics.configuration.detail: Check the endpoint, model and request parameters in service settings and test the connection. Save, then return here to retry.
diagnostics.configuration-save.title: Could not confirm the configuration was saved
diagnostics.configuration-save.detail: The connection check has not started. Wait a moment and retry; your entered values are preserved. If this continues, reopen settings and check the configuration.
diagnostics.rate-limit.title: The service is rate limited or out of quota
diagnostics.rate-limit.detail: Wait before retrying, or check quota and select another service in settings. Your selection will not change automatically.
diagnostics.timeout.title: Translation timed out
diagnostics.timeout.detail: Retry the translation. If this continues, check your network or test the connection and adjust the request timeout in service settings.
diagnostics.network.title: Cannot connect to the translation service
diagnostics.network.detail: Check your network and proxy, then retry. If other websites work, check the endpoint and test the connection in service settings.
diagnostics.provider.title: The service could not complete the translation
diagnostics.provider.detail: Try again later or select another service in settings.
diagnostics.unknown.title: Translation did not complete
diagnostics.unknown.detail: Retry or check the selected service. The diagnostic preview contains only the failure category and essential runtime information.
diagnostics.report.localOnly: Generated locally. Includes the error category and essential runtime information, without page text, URLs or credentials.
diagnostics.report.exportFailed: Export failed. Select and copy the preview.
diagnostics.ui.refresh-failed: Could not reload the page. Reload it manually and try again.
diagnostics.ui.source-closed: The original page is closed. Open it again.
diagnostics.ui.source-unavailable: The original page is closed or unavailable. Open the page you want to translate and retry from the extension.
diagnostics.ui.source-returned: Your page is active. Retry translation from the extension.
diagnostics.ui.source-return-hint: After checking your settings, return to your page to retry translation.
diagnostics.ui.first-use-start: Open a foreign-language page and translate. Choose a service above if needed.
diagnostics.ui.first-use-translating: Translating. Read the result on the page when ready.
diagnostics.ui.first-use-ready: Translation is ready. You can also select text or use the paragraph shortcut.
